title: Electrical Construction Manager
summary: Oversee electrically biased construction operations across large-scale projects, coordinating teams and subcontractors for safe, timely, high-quality delivery.
description: Oversee electrically biased construction operations across large-scale projects, coordinating teams and subcontractors for safe, timely, high-quality delivery.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Direct daily operations, subcontractors, suppliers and site records across projects.
Manage programmes, trade sequencing, logistics and resource planning.
Inspect works for design compliance and quality.
Enforce EHS standards, review and implement RAMS, resolve site issues and delays.
Liaise with project managers, engineers and commercial teams and report performance.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: 5+ years as a Construction Manager in construction or M&E, ideally MEP/data centre, industrial or commercial projects.
Relevant HNC/HND, degree or equivalent qualification; SMSTS certification essential.
Knowledge of health and safety regulations, including CDM.
Strong subcontractor leadership, organisation and communication.
Unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Safety leadership, First Aid readiness, time management and collaborative problem-solving.
